jobs.occupation: Risk Advisory Analyst - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international organisation active in the financial services sector. Based in Brussels, they operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment, supporting businesses with complex financial and trade-related challenges.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess credit and insurance applications linked to international transactions
• Conduct financial, qualitative and risk analysis on companies and projects
• Evaluate political, economic and country risks impacting transactions
• Prepare recommendations and propose tailored risk solutions
• Present assessments to internal decision-making committees
• Build relationships with local and international stakeholders
• Contribute to process improvements and internal development initiatives

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law or a related field
• Initial experience in finance, credit analysis, insurance or risk management is a strong asset
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations
• Structured, accurate and able to work independently
• Excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Accounting - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established european organisation active in the financial services sector, with easily accessible offices in Brussels. You will lead a close-knit accounting team within a collaborative environment known for its positive and supportive culture

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coach and develop a team of two accounting professionals
• Oversee day-to-day general accounting activities and IFRS reporting processes
• Review and validate the trial balance to ensure the accuracy of financial statements
• Coordinate VAT returns, annual accounts and tax compliance obligations
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and statutory obligations

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, audit or financial analysis
• Previous experience managing an accounting team is a strong asset
• Fluent in French and English; Dutch is considered an advantage
• Solid knowledge of SAP, IFRS standards, VAT regulations and financial reporting
• Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail and continuous improvement focus

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Inside Sales | German Market | Antwerp | On-site

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.

• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.

Our client is an industrial company.

Jobomschrijving

• Assistance with year-end closing and reporting. Knowledge of both local GAAP and IFRS is required.
• Assistance with the Corporate Income Tax (CIT) calculation, with support from the Tax Manager.

• Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP is considered a plus).

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.
